yamlCheck.explanation: The current-play span runs from July 13 through the late third-travel-day inn stay, July 18. The tree next morning, intervening logistics/final-business mornings, explicit July 16 departure, and three inclusive travel days fit five civil transitions. Exact logistics placement within July 14–15 remains loose; no extra overnight is added at the end. The undated mirror history does not extend the adventure span.
